name: Clean Digital
description: Neutral baseline: physical camera only, plus imperceptible grain to unify a project.
rationale: The 'off' look that still goes through the same pipeline, so cutting between looked and clean shots keeps a consistent texture floor. A whisper of fine grain (dither) prevents banding in gradients and matches the noise floor of the artifact looks. No color or camera overrides — your view transform and sensor are respected.
